title: merge refusals other than an empty forge (another branch, no forge project, gh arm) exit 1, where tools.md says 2
goal: backlog.py merge on a remote that names no forge project, on the gh arm, or for a branch that is no item's own code/<id> exits 2 as kb/_self/tools.md says (bl_forge.target and merge_own raise a plain Refused, which backlog.py main maps to exit 1), or the doc and the cmd_merge docstring say exit 1.

run: import sys,os,json,tempfile; sys.path.insert(0,"_tools"); t=tempfile.mkdtemp(); open(t+"/backlog.json","w").write(json.dumps({"item_dir":"items","forge":"github","id_prefixes":{"story":"ST"}})); os.makedirs(t+"/items"); import backlog,bl_land; bl_land.need=lambda *a,**k: None; sys.argv=["backlog.py","--root",t,"merge","ST-aaaaaaaa"]; c=backlog.main(); assert c==2, c
